name: Steal Voice
body:
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 240
School necromancy; Level arcanist 2, bard 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, skald 2, sorcerer 2, witch 2, wizard 2
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V
Effect
Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration permanent (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes
Description
The target’s throat constricts, giving it the caster croak spellblight (see Ultimate Magic).
